record_hash_contract: input_sha256 hashes the exact retained tool input UTF-8 string. output_sha256 hashes its matching payload.output value serialized as JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and default ASCII escaping. Timestamps and call IDs locate private records; raw sessions are not public.
